def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):

    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w

        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []

            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))

        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),

        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }

    # The starting shot contains no central balls or shadows. Twenty frames
    # later both end patches are unobstructed, allowing exact source restoration.
    bg = hi[0].copy()
    bg[240:385, 75:215] = hi[20, 240:385, 75:215]
    bg[230:390, 1070:1220] = hi[20, 230:390, 1070:1220]
    return bg


def support_paths(p):
    # Use the near-stationary return segment in the flat part; preserve the
    # factual geometry of the ramps (not a generic screen-space parabola).
    paths = []
    for i in [0, 1]:
        pts = p[7:30, i]
        distance = abs(pts[:, 0]-127.825)
        ordering = np.argsort(distance)
        dd = np.r_[0, 10, 16, distance[ordering]]
        # Heights are measured at color bounding centers; the silhouettes have
        # a small asymmetry due to their highlights.
        yy = np.r_[[71.1, 71.1, 70.9] if i == 0 else [71.45, 71.45, 71.2], pts[ordering, 1]]
        # monotone distance nodes
        ids = np.argsort(dd);dd,yy=dd[ids],yy[ids]
        paths.append(PchipInterpolator(dd, yy, extrapolate=False))
    def y_at(x, i):
        d = abs(x-127.825)
        if d > 98:
            return float(paths[i](98))-.145*(d-98)
        return float(paths[i](d))
    return y_at


def make_assets(hi, bg, p):
    # Registered source sprites. A small, smooth matte only affects the edge;
    # the interior is original RGB, including material, texture and highlights.
    donors = [0, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19, 22, 24, 26, 28, 40, 48, 60, 72]
    assets = [[], []]
    half = 40
    u = (np.arange(2*half+1)-half)/5
    U, V = np.meshgrid(u, u)
    for i in [0, 1]:
        for t in donors:
            cx, cy = p[t, i]
            # centers corrected for the brighter edge pixels, measured from
            # source-vs-background component boundaries.
            far = np.clip((abs(cx-127.825)-22)/70, 0, 1)
            acx = cx + ((.12 if i == 0 else -.10)*far)
            acy = cy + (.12 if i == 0 else -.23)
            rx = 5.13 + .40*far
            ry = 5.50 - .19*far
            xx, yy = np.meshgrid((acx+u)*5, (acy+u)*5)
            fg = cv2.remap(hi[t], xx.astype(np.float32), yy.astype(np.float32), cv2.INTER_CUBIC, borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)
            oldbg = cv2.remap(bg, xx.astype(np.float32), yy.astype(np.float32), cv2.INTER_CUBIC, borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)
            radial = np.sqrt((U/rx)**2 + (V/ry)**2)
            edge_alpha = np.clip((1.028-radial)/.055, 0, 1)
            # Difference matte on the narrow antialiased outline, to avoid
            # copying floor colored pixels around the perimeter.
            diff = abs(fg.astype(float)-oldbg).max(2)
            diffalpha = np.clip((diff-2)/18, 0, 1)
            alpha = edge_alpha*np.where(radial < .90, 1., diffalpha)
            assets[i].append(dict(t=t, distance=abs(cx-127.825), center=(acx,acy),
                                  image=fg.astype(float), alpha=alpha, rx=rx, ry=ry))
        assets[i].sort(key=lambda s:s['distance'])
    return assets


def pair_assets(assets, d):
    distances=np.array([a['distance'] for a in assets])
    if d <= distances[0]: return assets[0], assets[0], 0.
    if d >= distances[-1]:return assets[-1], assets[-1], 0.
    k=np.searchsorted(distances,d)
    w=(d-distances[k-1])/(distances[k]-distances[k-1])
    # Smooth source-material transition between adjacent registrations.
    w=w*w*(3-2*w)
    return assets[k-1],assets[k],w


def composite_ball(canvas, assets, x, y, i):
    d=abs(x-127.825)
    a,b,w=pair_assets(assets[i], d)
    # Maintain original dimensions. Changing mass is not changing marble size.
    far=np.clip((d-22)/70,0,1)
    rx=5.13+.40*far;ry=5.50-.19*far
    x=x+((.12 if i==0 else -.10)*far)
    y=y+(.12 if i==0 else -.23)
    left=max(0,int(np.floor((x-7)*5)));right=min(1280,int(np.ceil((x+7)*5)))
    top=max(0,int(np.floor((y-7)*5)));bottom=min(720,int(np.ceil((y+7)*5)))
    X,Y=np.meshgrid(np.arange(left,right)/5-x,np.arange(top,bottom)/5-y)
    def sample(asset):
        mx=(X*asset['rx']/rx*5+40).astype(np.float32)
        my=(Y*asset['ry']/ry*5+40).astype(np.float32)
        rgb=cv2.remap(asset['image'].astype(np.float32),mx,my,cv2.INTER_CUBIC,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)
        alpha=cv2.remap(asset['alpha'].astype(np.float32),mx,my,cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)
        return rgb,alpha
    rgb1,alpha1=sample(a);rgb2,alpha2=sample(b)
    alpha=np.clip(alpha1*(1-w)+alpha2*w,0,1)[:,:,None]
    rgb=rgb1*(1-w)+rgb2*w
    target=canvas[top:bottom,left:right]
    target[:]=target*(1-alpha)+rgb*alpha


def shadow(canvas, hi, bg, p, assets, x, y, i):
    # Source-derived contact and soft reflected shadows, kept separately from
    # the opaque marble. This avoids dragging patches of ramp with the marble.
    d=abs(x-127.825)
    a,b,w=pair_assets(assets[i],d)
    xmin=max(0,int((x-17)*5));xmax=min(1280,int((x+17)*5))
    ymin=max(0,int((y+3.5)*5));ymax=min(720,int((y+27)*5))
    X,Y=np.meshgrid(np.arange(xmin,xmax)/5-x,np.arange(ymin,ymax)/5-y)
    acc=np.zeros((*X.shape,3),float)
    for asset,weight in [(a,1-w),(b,w)]:
        if weight==0:continue
        t=asset['t'];cx,cy=p[t,i]
        mirror=1 if (cx-127.825)*(x-127.825)>=0 else -1
        # Track local contact plane slope when moving from one arm to the other.
        oldsign=np.sign(cx-127.825);newsign=np.sign(x-127.825)
        oldslope=-.145*oldsign*np.clip((abs(cx-127.825)-14)/10,0,1)
        newslope=-.145*newsign*np.clip((d-14)/10,0,1)
        mx=(cx+X*mirror)*5
        my=(cy+Y+X*mirror*oldslope-X*newslope)*5
        old=cv2.remap(hi[t],mx.astype(np.float32),my.astype(np.float32),cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)
        oldbase=cv2.remap(bg,mx.astype(np.float32),my.astype(np.float32),cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)
        difference=old.astype(float)-oldbase.astype(float)
        # Only shadows, not remnants of the source sphere at the bottom edge.
        lum=difference.mean(2)
        # Tight negative component near contact, soft reflection lower down.
        gate=np.clip((Y-4.8)/1.2,0,1)*np.clip((27-Y)/3,0,1)
        gate*=np.clip((17-abs(X))/3,0,1)
        gate*=np.clip((-lum-2)/9,0,1)
        contact=np.exp(-((X+oldsign*2.5*mirror)/9)**4)
        reflection=np.exp(-(X/9)**4)
        gate*=np.where(Y<12,contact,reflection)
        acc+=weight*np.minimum(difference,0)*gate[:,:,None]
    canvas[ymin:ymax,xmin:xmax]+=acc


def main():
    source,hi=get_source()
    p=track(hi)
    bg=clean_background(hi,p)
    y_at=support_paths(p)
    assets=make_assets(hi,bg,p)
    positions=dynamics()
    frames=source.copy()
    for f in range(34,96):
        # unchanged camera, wood, decor, lighting and original time line
        canvas=hi[f].astype(float)
        canvas[235:490,:]=bg[235:490,:]
        x=positions[f-34]
        y=np.array([y_at(x[i],i) for i in [0,1]])
        for i in [0,1]:shadow(canvas,hi,bg,p,assets,x[i],y[i],i)
        for i in [0,1]:composite_ball(canvas,assets,x[i],y[i],i)
        frame=Image.fromarray(np.clip(canvas,0,255).round().astype(np.uint8))
        frames[f]=np.asarray(frame.resize((256,144),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS))
    artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
    np.savez_compressed(ROOT/'motion_diagnostics.npz',source_centers=p,edited_x=positions)
    print('Saved',frames.shape,frames.dtype,'at 24 fps.')
    print('Factual approach retained through frame 34 (1-based).')
    print('Edited horizontal bounds:', positions.min(0),positions.max(0))


if __name__=='__main__':main()
